descriptionHtml: A webinar on ‘Applications of Optical Fiber and Microwave Links’ was held at 7.00 p.m. on 2nd April 2021 via zoom. It was organized by the Industrial Application Society (IAS, IEEE) of University of Peradeniya. The webinar was conducted by Eng. Buddika Wijethunge, B.Sc eng(Hons) University of peradeniya, a project technical specialist of -CTS (Canada).
